description: EE1: Imposter Ditto leads in p1's right slot and transforms into the opposite foe, Incineroar in p2's left slot (Showdown `side.foe.active[length - 1 - position]`). Ditto (Speed 100) starts before Incineroar (80; its Iron Ball keeps the order the same by action Speed): it transforms (species, stored stats, types, 5-PP copies of the target's moves) and gains Intimidate, whose Start lowers both foes' Attack; then Incineroar's Intimidate lowers Snorlax and the transformed Ditto. The turn: Ditto uses its copied Protect (PP 5 -> 4), Incineroar Taunts Snorlax; the transformed Ditto (80 Speed) and Incineroar (40 with Iron Ball) do not tie.
